article_title: Capsized tanker carrying 7,000 tonnes of diesel to be towed away from Ibiza
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level A; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, vocabulary in context, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A capsized diesel tanker being stabilised and towed to Cartagena
A new ferry service opening between Ibiza and Barcelona
A plan to expand oil drilling near Valencia
A cargo ship completing a routine journey to Algeciras
tasks.correct_answer: A capsized diesel tanker being stabilised and towed to Cartagena
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת במכלית דיזל שהתהפכה ליד איביזה ובמבצע לגרירתה לקרטחנה תוך בדיקת סכנת הזיהום.

tasks.prompt: Why was Cartagena chosen as the destination for the tanker?
options: It is the nearest port to Ibiza
It is the tanker's registered home port
It is the only port meeting the technical needs for cargo extraction and repairs
It has no environmental protection rules
tasks.correct_answer: It is the only port meeting the technical needs for cargo extraction and repairs
tasks.explanation_hebrew: משרד התחבורה הספרדי אמר שקרטחנה היא הנמל היחיד שעומד בדרישות הטכניות לריקון המטען ולתיקונים.

tasks.prompt: What happened to the 17 crew members?
options: All were rescued; the chief engineer later died in hospital
Six remained missing at sea
All returned to work on the tanker
The entire crew reached Cartagena without injuries
tasks.correct_answer: All were rescued; the chief engineer later died in hospital
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כל 17 אנשי הצוות חולצו, אך המהנדס הראשי מת מאוחר יותר בבית החולים ושישה טופלו בפציעות קלות.

tasks.prompt: What does “partially submerged” mean in the article?
options: Completely repaired in port
Travelling below normal speed
Floating with no part in the water
Under the water only in part
tasks.correct_answer: Under the water only in part
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי partially submerged פירושו שרק חלק מן כלי השיט נמצא מתחת למים, ולא שהוא שקע לחלוטין.

tasks.prompt: What did inspectors find about the ship's fuel tanks?
options: They had released all 7,000 tonnes of diesel
They were intact
They had been removed before the accident
They contained heavy fuel oil from the Prestige
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הבדיקה הראתה שמכלי הדלק של האונייה שלמים, ולכן החשש מדליפה גדולה פחת.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article mention Ibiza's Posidonia oceanica seagrass?
options: To explain why local fuel is expensive
To show where the crew planned to sail
To show why a spill could threaten an important marine ecosystem
To describe the material used to repair the tanker
tasks.correct_answer: To show why a spill could threaten an important marine ecosystem
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אזכור עשב הים מדגיש את הרגישות הסביבתית של האזור ואת הנזק האפשרי שדליפה הייתה עלולה לגרום.

tasks.prompt: Describe the sequence from the distress call to the tanker capsizing.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את קריאת המצוקה ביום רביעי בלילה, הדיווח על דליפה ועל נטייה של 90 מעלות, וההתהפכות בשעות המוקדמות של יום חמישי.
expected_points: Rescuers in Valencia received a distress call late on Wednesday.
Minutes later the vessel reported a leak.
The crew said the tanker was leaning at a 90-degree angle.

tasks.prompt: Give two pieces of evidence that the immediate pollution risk appeared to be under control.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להביא שתי ראיות מן הכתבה, כגון שלמות מכלי הדלק, היעלמות הכתם הקטן והערכת הרשויות שהמצב התייצב.
expected_points: Inspectors found the fuel tanks intact.
Prime Minister Sánchez said the available information suggested no leak was occurring.
A small slick around the vessel disappeared.
A maritime official said the situation was stabilised.

tasks.prompt: Write 3–4 sentences explaining why towing the Med Emre is a challenging operation.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהמכלית הפוכה ושקועה חלקית, נושאת עד 7,000 טון דיזל, נמצאת הרחק מן החוף, ויש למנוע זיהום תוך גרירה וריקון בטוח של המטען.
expected_points: The tanker is capsized and partially submerged.
It carries up to 7,000 tonnes of diesel.
It must be moved from offshore waters to Cartagena without causing a spill.
Cargo extraction and repairs require specialised port facilities.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the accident, response and environmental concern in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את מקום ההתהפכות, מצב הצוות, ממצאי הבדיקה, יעד הגרירה והחשיבות הסביבתית של אזור איביזה.
expected_points: The Med Emre capsized near Ibiza while travelling from Algeciras to Barcelona.
All 17 crew members were rescued, but the chief engineer later died.
The fuel tanks were found intact and no major spill was confirmed.
Authorities plan to tow the vessel to Cartagena for extraction and repairs.
Pollution monitoring matters because Ibiza has a protected and biodiverse marine environment.
